raids.abdendriel.dragons.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There are dragons rising in Draconia!
raids.abdendriel.warwolf.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Many aggressive beasts are roaming south of Ab'Dendriel! Take care!
raids.abdendriel.wasp_bear.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Forrest animals spread out close to Ab'Dendriel!
raids.ankrahmun.bone_beast.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Bonebeasts are rattling down in the Ankrahmun Dipthrah tombs.
raids.ankrahmun.bone_beast.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Bonebeasts roaming around in the Ankrahmun Dipthrah tombs.
raids.ankrahmun.cobra.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There's something sizzling in the Ankrahmun Dipthrah tombs.
raids.ankrahmun.cobra.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Even more sizzling in the Ankrahmun Dipthrah tombs.
raids.ankrahmun.cobra.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Poison overflow in the Ankrahmun Dipthrah tombs!
raids.ankrahmun.gargoyle.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There is something stony moving down in the Ankrahmun Rahemos tombs.
raids.ankrahmun.gargoyle.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Gargoyle attack in the Ankrahmun Rahemos tombs!
raids.ankrahmun.nomad.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Nomad scouts have been sighted close to the gates to Ankrahmun.
raids.ankrahmun.nomad.msg_2:
[ZH_TW] The desert nomads are launching a full scale attack on Ankrahmun.
		Some might even have slipped through the defences!
raids.ankrahmun.scarab.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Unusual frequent scarab sightings at the gates of Ankrahmun
raids.ankrahmun.scarab.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Ancient scarabs are leading an attack on Ankrahmun.
raids.ankrahmun.terramite.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something is moving under the surface in the sand north of Ankrahmun!
raids.carlin.orc.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Some Orcs are assembling in the woods between Carlin and Northport.
raids.carlin.orc.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Orcs attacking Carlin from the north-east!
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something is moving to the icy grounds of Folda.
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Many Yetis are emerging from the icy mountains of Folda.
raids.carlin.yeti.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Numerous Yetis are dominating Folda, beware!
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_1: [ZH_TW] An immense force is approaching Draconia.
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Get prepare mortals, the visit of Chayenne is near.
raids.chayenne.chayenne.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Chayenne has returned to his citadel once more. Be careful there.
raids.darashia.arachir_the_ancient_one.m: [ZH_TW] Beware of Arachir the Ancient One!
raids.darashia.lions.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There are more lions than usual west of Darashia.
raids.darashia.lions.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Even more lions west of Darashia!
raids.darashia.lions.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Zomba, the king of lions is roaming the Darashia desert!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Minotaurs are preparing an attack in the Darashia Minotaur pyramid!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Minotaurs are attacking Darashia from the north!
raids.darashia.minotaurs.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Minotaurs are advancing to Darashia grom the north!
raids.darashia.pirates.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Pillage and plunder! Pirates have been sighted north of Darashia!.
raids.darashia.priestesses.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The priestesses in Drefia are preparing a black celebration.
raids.darashia.undead_darashia.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Sightings of undead, west of Darashia! Imminent invasion is suspected!
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_1: [ZH_TW] An ancient evil is awakening in the grimvale mines.
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_2:
[ZH_TW] Werewolfs entities are entering the
	mortal realm in the grimvale mines.
raids.edron.feroxa.msg_3: [ZH_TW] The Feroxa master has revealed itself in the mines of grimvale.
raids.edron.goblins.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Goblins are converging west of Edron.
raids.edron.orc.msg_1:
[ZH_TW] Deep under Edron, the Orc population seems to grow rapidly.
		Be careful and take a rope with you!
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Orshabaal's minions are working on his return to the World. LEAVE Edron at once, mortals.
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Orshabaal is about to make his way into the mortal realm. Run for your lives!
raids.edron.orshabaal.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Orshabaal has been summoned from hell to plague the lands of mortals once again.
raids.edron.warlock.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Some monks have gathered at a stone circle west of Edron. They seem to be up to something.
raids.edron.warlock.msg_2: [ZH_TW] More monks have gathered at a stone circle west of Edron. Something terrible is going to happen!
raids.edron.warlock.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Run! Warlocks east of Edron! There seems to be a very unholy gathering!
raids.farmine.beetles.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Lancer beetles troop up in Farmine. Beware!
raids.farmine.beetles.msg_2: [ZH_TW] A pack of lancer beetles heads towards the coast!
raids.farmine.draptor.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The dragons of the Dragonblaze Mountains have  descended to Zao to protect the lizardkin!
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There seems to be a big gnarlhoud gang in Zao Steppe.
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_2: [ZH_TW] The gnarlhounds seem to multiply by the minute.
raids.farmine.gnarlhounds.msg_3: [ZH_TW] The gnarlhounds roam free in the Zao Steppe. Watch out!
raids.farmine.zulazza_the_corruptor.msg_: [ZH_TW] A massive orc force is gathering at the gates of Zzaion.
[ZH_TW] Orc reinforcements have arrived at the gates of Zzaion! The gates are under heavy attack!.
[ZH_TW] More orc reinforcements have arrived at the gates of Zzaion! The gates are under heavy attack!.
[ZH_TW] The gates to Zzaion have been breached! Orcs are invading the city!.
[ZH_TW] More orcs have arrived in Zzaion! The city is under attack! Strong lizard leaders have come to defend the city.
raids.kazordoon.goblins.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Goblins are preparing to attack Kazordoon from Femor Hills!
raids.kazordoon.goblins.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Danger! Now the goblin leaders attack Kazordoon from Femor Hills!
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The seals on Ferumbras old cidatel are glowing. Prepare for HIS return mortals.
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Ferumbras return is at hand. The Edron Academy calls for Heroes to fight that evil.
raids.liberty_bay.ferumbras.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Ferumbras has returned to his citadel once more. Stop him before its too late.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The ancient volcano on Goroma slowly becomes active once again.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_2: [ZH_TW] There is an evil presence at the volcano of Goroma.
raids.liberty_bay.morgaroth.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Evil Cultists have called an ancient evil into the volcano on Goroma. Beware of its power mortals.
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something is moving in the depths of the sea around Liberty Bay
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Numerous Quara fins have been sighted in the seas around Liberty Bay.
raids.liberty_bay.quaras.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Quara emerged from the sea to attack Liberty Bay.
raids.liberty_bay.tigers.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Majestic creatures with stripes roam the small desert at Meriana.
raids.liberty_bay.tortoises.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Slowly but steady, the population of tortoises grows on liberty island.
raids.port_hope.kongras.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Lizards Sentinels seem to attack Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.kongras.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Lizards are advancing to Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.lizards.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Lizards Sentinels seem to attack Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.lizards.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Lizards are advancing to Port Hope from Chor.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something bad is happening deep, deep down under Banuta.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Something is sizzling deep under many sheets of soil in Banuta.
raids.port_hope.serpent_spawn.msg_3: [ZH_TW] Hordes of slippery spawns slither in Deeper Banuta!
raids.port_hope.terrorbirds.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Terrorbirds have been sighted in Trapwood south-east of Port Hope!
raids.rookgaard.rottie2.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something is moving in the northern grounds of the Rookgaard.
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Something out of the ordinary, it's better we hide now!
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_2: [ZH_TW] His strength is unlimited, the demons kneeling before him .!
raids.roshamuul.gaz_haragoth.msg_3: [ZH_TW] The dreaded Gaz'Haragoth is invading the land from prison.
raids.roshamuul.omrafir.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Omrafir is about to make his way into the roshamuul prison. Run for your lives!
raids.svargrond.barba_bittermor.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Barbarians are gathering at Bittermor. They seem to be up to something.
raids.svargrond.barba_bittermor.msg_2: [ZH_TW] The barbarian pack is roaming around in Bittermor.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Scouts report a barbarian army gathering near Svargrond.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Some invaders might try to access Svargrond via the ice to the south west.
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_4: [ZH_TW] The barbarians attacks on Svargrond are becoming more and more fierce!
raids.svargrond.barba_svar.msg_5: [ZH_TW] The barbarians are preparing for a final assault on Svargrond. Hide or fight!
raids.svargrond.barbarian.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Scouts report a barbarian army gathering near Svargrond
raids.svargrond.barbarian.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Some invaders might try to access Svargrond via the ice to the North.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_1: [ZH_TW] An ancient evil is awakening in the mines beneath Hrodmir.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Demonic entities are entering the mortal realm in the Hrodmir mines.
raids.svargrond.ghazbaran.msg_3: [ZH_TW] The demonic master has revealed itself in the mines of Hrodmir.
raids.svargrond.ice_golems.msg_1: [ZH_TW] There is a sudden rise in ice golem population in Formogar mines.
raids.thais.cyclops.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Let da mashing begin! Cyclops riot east of Thais.
raids.thais.orcs.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Orc activity near Thais reported! Beware!
raids.venore.elves.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Elf Scouts have been sighted near Venore!
raids.venore.feverish_citizen.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Feverish Citizens are invading the streets of Venore!
raids.venore.hunter.msg_1: [ZH_TW] Hunters on the hunt north of the Green Claw Swamp.
raids.venore.the_old_widow.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The mating season of the giant spiders is at hand. Leave the plains of havoc as fast as you can.
raids.venore.the_old_widow.msg_2: [ZH_TW] Giant spiders have gathered on the plains of havoc for their mating season. Beware!
raids.venore.undead.msg_1: [ZH_TW] The dead of the plains of havoc are becoming restless!
raids.venore.undead.msg_2: [ZH_TW] A veritable army of undead is amassing in the plains of havoc, beware!
raids.venore.undead.msg_3: [ZH_TW] The dreaded banshee lead their undead minions to claim the plains of havoc!
